text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. Deciding I might as well grab some hot chocolate, I stopped by the cafeteria, and—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the chocolates!
I received your feelings loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna make you happy!
So make sure you stick with me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Geez... hehe, alright, alright, I'll tag along.
Can't be helped, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, at it again, huh.
You sure are popular, Epi.
...Well, they're all your "destiny" after all~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that guy hits on absolutely anyone and everyone!
It's hilarious, honestly~.
...No chocolate for him, though...

Ghhhk,
the complex emotions of Uma Musume...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My chest... aghhh!
It hurts so bad, GHOOOST...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san is cheerful and straightforward,
spreading destiny to so many Umamusume...
Everyone watches her with a smile, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "It's true that some girls go totally hardcore! But Epi-san cares about everyone, and destiny isn't just about oneself, so it's kinda like—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah, aaaaaah!
I hope everyone finds happineeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To break down and summarize what was just said,
does it mean the girls Epiphaneia felt a destined connection with
are feeling a bit lonely?"
choice_data_list: (For now, maybe I'll try telling Epi)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I see! I get it!
Then let's make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Because this situation is totally not okay!! My dream is to make everyone happy... but instead, I'm making them anxious!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In short, you just wanna see what I'm made of when I'm serious, right?
Then that'll give ya peace of mind!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To begin with, Epiphaneia's goal is to make everyone happy by awakening the voice of destiny within them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than connecting one-on-one,
she aims to spread happiness from a higher vantage point—
philanthropically, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely... she wants Epiphaneia's feelings
to be directed toward her and her "alone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could what she's aiming for actually be the exact opposite of "happiness"? When I tell her that...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Even so,
I'll make them happy!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Giving it to only that child is definitely tough! But... I absolutely refuse to leave them feeling anxious!!
choice_data_list: ...Then I'd better give it my all.
...Then you'd better give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to hear your opinion!
What could someone do that would make you feel at ease!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recalled the times when things Epiphaneia
did for me brought me peace of mind.
There were plenty, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'll be totally fine, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She observes people so carefully...
and validates them with her absolute confidence.
That feeling of "being seen"—
choice_data_list: Wouldn't that give us some peace of mind?
Don't you think that would give us some peace of mind?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm confident!
I know everything about the girls I feel fated with, after all!
choice_data_list: And while we're at it, in the spirit of Valentine's—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, making handmade chocolate to give out... That's great!
I can customize it for each person!
choice_data_list: By the way, what's with that outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: If we're gonna cook, we oughta have aprons on!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if I'm gonna make chocolate anyway—
Yeah, the voice of destiny agrees with me!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Get a streaming camera
and studio ready! Right now!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Reach everyone!!!!
The Fated Valentine Project!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Can everyone see me!?
All you people of my destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
""Hey, turn on the monitor!!"
"Epi? What's she doing~?"
"Wait... isn't that a ramen shop?" "LMAO.""

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Talking about that fated 'everyone' again...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm making chocolates for everyone!
Watch closely and see how much love I put into them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We're making "Chocolate Carrots"!
First, let's melt down the chocolate!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Once it starts melting, mix in the chocolate!
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!?
It's all completely gone!!
choice_data_list: I need to mix it a bit more quietly...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Crazy momentum!" "Fateful Valentine's
Project... Is Epi pulling a desperate gag?"
"Ahahaha, man, she's hilarious as always~"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...They're totally laughing at us.
Ugh, seriously, what are we even doing—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“――No, I'll go buy fresh chocolate!
I want to make sure every single person gets a different flavor!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So I'll replace what was lost!
No matter what it takes, everyone will get theirs!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Otherwise—how else am I supposed to show them that I'm truly looking right at them?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to smile! No, I'll *make* them smile! That's my true resolve!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...!! Thank you!!
Let's get the other things done in the meantime!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna make everyone!! Every single one of you!!
—Haaaaappyyyyyyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Epi...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, that you were serious.
...I have to accept it, without asking for too much—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia successfully made "chocolate carrots" for everyone she had sensed destiny in. And then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Here you go, this one's yours!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You always wear a blue hair accessory, but
whenever you're really fired up, you switch
to a pink ribbon, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!
Were you watching...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You've gotta give it your all these days, right?
So here's some pink chocolate as a present!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for feeling our destiny together!
—I promise I'll make you happy!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly.
..................I'm counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she understood that Epiphaneia was being serious.
...Though deep down, she might have held different feelings...
choice_data_list: (Epi and everyone are such good kids.)
(Epi and everyone are such good kids, aren't they?)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew!!
I'm so glad everyone ended up smiling!!
choice_data_list: Good work, you gave it your all.
Good work, you gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much
for helping out a bunch too!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why!
This is a token of my feelings!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Correct! It's a rich hot chocolate
made by melting down all the leftover chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "While you were out shopping for supplies, I made this as a surprise♪"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When you came to the cafeteria at lunchtime...
you actually came to drink hot chocolate, didn't you?
choice_data_list: ...! Come to think of it... but why?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course I noticed!
But you didn't drink it after that and called me over instead, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So I figured it'd fit your current mood!
I'm always watching you closely, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She took the cup in hand and was about to take a sip.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Stop!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Gonna sit down, right?
Here, use this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I laid down the handkerchief Epiphaneia handed me, sat down,
and took a sip from the cup.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inside the mouth—an outrageous sweetness ran wild!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
What's the matter!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I helped prepare the chocolate myself, I had a general idea
of how sweet it should be. There was plenty of dark chocolate,
so simply mixing it wouldn't have turned out like this.
choice_data_list: Epi... what about the toppings on this...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's sugar!!
I poured a whoooole bunch on!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You really ran all over the place for me, didn't you?
That's why I want you to get some proper relaxation!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Is it good!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right! Heheh♪
Thanks again, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sweetness of various chocolates mingled together,
offering a new flavor with every sip...
The more I drank, the warmer my body and heart became.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, did my determination... get through to you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Today's chocolate is... my heartfelt feelings
for everyone with whom I felt a bond of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that goes for the hot chocolate too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm sure you're not worried at all!
Even so, I just wanted to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "I'll keep saying it until you take me seriously!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Don't you forget it! You are my one and only—destiny!"
